why: Tests step for judgment slice E31 (preferEffectArray in oxlint-plugins/ and stylelint.config.ts, all exam paths, no build step). The checker has no quick fix for this check (the client fixed 0 of 10 hits in advice.ts), so a scratchpad codemod on oxc-parser rewrote each flagged call from the checker's own hit list: xs.m(a) to Arr.m(xs, a) for map, filter, flatMap, some, every, join and forEach, and Array.isArray to Arr.isArray. A second pass turned each nest the first made from a chain into pipe(xs, Arr.y(a), Arr.x(b)), in the chain's order, which also fixed the inference errors the nests raised. The 24 find, findLast, findIndex and toSorted hits answer an Option, so each was rewritten by hand and followed to its uses. No lock line was added.
